subject: G-COST-4 vol-target gap gate in 03-trading-strategies/realtime_challenge/proof/g_cost_gates.py

prior_state.todo_claim: A10 marked [x]: G-COST-1..4 wired to CI; G-COST-4 KILL vol-target gap 240.9 bp/day over 24 sessions
prior_state.actual_code: 24 hourly-SPACED samples of overlapping 24h returns; rv annualised by (var**0.5)*(24*sqrt(365)); verdict = KILL iff |vol_target - buy_and_hold| > 5 bp/day

defects_found.detail: rets built as closes[i]/closes[i-24]-1 for EVERY i in range(24,len) on HOURLY bars, then take last 24 -> 24 hourly-spaced samples of overlapping 24h returns spanning ~2 calendar days, not 24 daily sessions. The n=24 'sessions' label is false.

rv annualised a DAILY variance with (var**0.5)*(24*365**0.5) = daily_std*24*sqrt(365) = 458.52, instead of sqrt(365)=19.10. Since rets are daily returns, this oversizes rv 24x, so scale = min(1, 0.10/rv) is ~24x too small. Empirically the committed scale averaged 0.058 (5.8% exposure) vs 0.822 (~82%) with correct annualisation on the same window.

Verdict = KILL iff |vol_target - buy_and_hold| > 5 bp/day, direction-blind. A long-only de-risking overlay MUST diverge from buy-and-hold whenever the asset trends: it gives up upside in rallies and loses less in crashes. |gap| therefore measures the size of the asset move, not overlay quality, and fires in both directions.

sign_flip_proof.detail: The SAME committed gate produced opposite-signed buy-and-hold results while KILLing both times, proving |gap| tracks the asset move, not the overlay.

committed_code_reproduced_same_window.note: Independent re-fetch of BTC/USDT 1h, limit 480, committed logic re-run (overlapping 24h returns, 24x annualisation).

corrected_annualisation_only.note: Same overlapping window, ONLY rv annualisation fixed to sqrt(365). Gap falls 243.4 -> 68.4 (3.6x smaller); signed effect shows overlay HELPED in this falling window (lost less).
corrected_annualisation_only.old_verdict_still_would_be: KILL (|gap|>5) — illustrating why |gap| is the wrong predicate

recast_live_run.note: Full recast: 24 NON-overlapping daily sessions, sqrt(365) annualisation, signed diagnostic, no |gap| KILL.

fix.verdict_semantics: ILL-POSED when measurable; UNMEASURABLE if book unreadable. No PASS/KILL on the retired |gap| band.
what_it_now_does: Uses NON-overlapping daily returns (advance 24 hourly bars per step) over a real 24-session window (fetch limit 760).
Annualises daily vol by sqrt(365) (correct) instead of 24*sqrt(365).
Reports the SIGNED overlay effect (vol_target - buy_and_hold) as a report-only diagnostic per framework 2c (report, do not wire), with mean exposure.
Retires the direction-blind |gap| KILL predicate with a documented reason.
fix.not_a_weakening: The |gap| predicate could never test overlay quality — a directionally de-risked overlay always diverges from buy-and-hold when the asset trends, in either sign (proven by the +246.3 rally / -255.2 crash sign flip, both KILL). Retiring a vacuous predicate is not lowering a live gate and passes no candidate; the overlay is NOT claimed to pass anything, and the overall run still KILLs on G-COST-1. Same precedent as the 2026-11-25 G-COST-3 recast.
